dedupe_keys.name: pre built sector coupled euro calliope model subnational european energy system model inputs ready for calliope 2010 2018 data

description: This Zenodo record by Bryn Pickering of ETH Zurich publishes pre-built, subnational-scale models of the sector-coupled Euro-Calliope European energy system, generated with a specific commit of the Euro-Calliope workflow and based on 2010 to 2018 input data, packaged ready to load into the Calliope modelling framework. Users create a given conda environment and select scenario overrides to include sectors: pooled or regionally isolated industrial fuel demand with synthetic fuel production, road transport with internal combustion and electric vehicles and smart charging constraints, heat and cooking demand with heat technologies, simplifying overrides, temporal resolution from 2 to 12 hours, underground methane storage, dynamic transmission link limits, frozen hydro capacities and biofuels. The note warns that a full hourly run takes about two days. Version 0.1 and version 0.1.1 are each a zip of about 690 MB, available for free download under CC BY 4.0, last updated in June 2023. Coverage is Europe at subnational resolution. Caveats: the models are fixed to one workflow commit and Calliope version, and later Euro-Calliope releases are not included. Simulation uses are ready-to-run European sector-coupled capacity expansion and system optimisation. Related records: model-calliope is the framework that runs them.
name: Pre-built sector-coupled Euro-Calliope model - subnational European energy system model inputs ready for Calliope (2010-2018 data)
